answer: Gate rewards behind an established-weight curve shaped like a mesa, not a canyon: new identities begin on the low canyon floor and must forge reputation through peer-attested work before reaching the flat mesa top where payouts saturate. Each sybil must independently forge non-replayable attestations from distinct established graders who stake bonded collateral slashed on collusion, so N fakes cost N times genuine work while the mesa cap keeps the marginal fake's yield near zero. Spend rises linearly; reward flattens, so identity-farming stays unprofitable.
